title: PhD Candidate — Optimal Planning for Space Surveillance Sensor Networks
description: Industrial PhD conducted in collaboration with Look Up Space. Research on optimal scheduling of heterogeneous space surveillance sensors (mechanically steered radars, phased array surveillance and tracking radars, telescopes, lasers, and RF sensors), under multi-domain constraints and environmental uncertainty.

title: Space Surveillance Research Engineer
description: Developing orbital mechanics algorithms for the SYNAPSE space surveillance platform.

title: Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Orbital Mechanics Expert
description: Consulting assignment focused on developing and improving orbital mechanics algorithms for collision-risk assessment, sensor visibility prediction, and ground-based measurement simulation.

title: M.Sc.A. in Artificial Intelligence
description: Master's degree specializing in aerospace and AI, with research in the LARCASE laboratory on deep learning for orbital maneuver detection and satellite behavior modeling. Coursework in deep learning, machine learning, probabilistic learning, and representation learning. Published two conference papers and one scientific poster.

title: Machine Learning Researcher
description: Researched data-driven orbital maneuver detection. Developed time-series deep learning forecasting models incorporating exogenous data (solar activity, ballistic coefficients) for orbital state prediction and correction of conventional numerical propagation models. Proposed conditioned Gaussian Mixture Models (CGMMs) for unsupervised anomaly detection based on external data, and a framework for maneuver characterization based on deep clustering and computer vision techniques applied to discrete wavelet transforms (DWTs).

title: Engineering Degree in Aerospace Mechanics
description: Engineering degree (master's-level qualification) specialized in orbital mechanics, applied mathematics, optimization, data science, and satellite mission analysis.

title: Data Science & Orbital Mechanics Intern
description: Developed an analysis framework for the Special Perturbation (SP) numerical propagation model. Created ML-based methods for satellite maneuverability characterization using Isolation Forest and XGBoost. Designed maneuver detection methods through covariance-error analysis and clustering (k-NN).

title: Auditor, 14th IHEDN Student Session
organisation: Institut des Hautes Études de la Défense Nationale, Paris
description: Studied French defense policy and geopolitics, covering multi-domain conflictuality, strategy and defense industries through seminars and workshops. Wrote a policy note on the challenges and opportunities of warfare robotization for the French army.
